text:
Maria (partnerships): FYI final runbook for Multicloud Mixer next Wed. Partners: NimbusEdge + AcmeCloud. Need AV confirm, demo table power, and sticker/tote routing. Live demo slot 11:15–11:35.

Tom H (events): AV reserved: HDMI + USB-C input + 2x wireless mics. Power strip & extension will be on table #4. Can we get 2 backup laptops staged?

Aisha (logistics): Packing list printed and labels ready. Dropoff Tue 9am at venue loading dock. Packing list:
```
- 10 demo laptops
- 3 dev kits (NVMe images)
- 300 stickers (round)
- 80 tote bags
- 2 tabletop banners
- 50 one-pagers (benchmarks)
```
Carrier: FedEx 3-day.

Samir (eng): Heads up — I won't bring the custom hardware boards. I'll provide a containerized fallback with pre-record + live remote SSH fallback. Fallback instructions are in the demo drive: https://internal.redwood/demo-fallback

Jordan (swag-coord): For the sticker/tote split we'll do NimbusEdge 40% / AcmeCloud 40% / Redwood 20%. I'll handle customs paperwork for EU shipments.

OpsBot: Reminder: create support rotation in #eng-oncall for 10:30–12:00 on event day.

Maria (partnerships): @Samir thanks. @Tom H can you confirm table #4 and mic count? Also need speaker bios for event page. @Jordan confirm courier pickup time.

Tom H (events): Table #4 confirmed. Wireless mics: 2 lav + 1 handheld. Speakers confirmed: Maria K (Redwood), Raj Patel (NimbusEdge), Lena Ortiz (AcmeCloud). Bios uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/MulticloudMixer/bios

Aisha (logistics): FedEx tracking placeholder: 1234567890. ETA Tue 14:30. Customs docket: PARTNERSHIP-CC-0426 if anything flagged.

Samir (eng): Fallback start command (on local laptop):
```
./start-demo.sh --image nimbus-fallback:latest --port 8080
```
I'll be on-call during the demo window and will drop a 1-page runbook in the drive.

Jordan (swag-coord): Courier pickup scheduled Tue 10:00. Manifest will be sent to @Maria and ops. I'll also bring an extra 50 stickers for overflow.

Maria (partnerships): One last ask — please prep 2 printed one-pagers with latency/cost benchmarks for the kiosk. @Samir can you verify numbers?

Samir (eng): Will push a short PDF by EOD with the latest numbers.

Tom H (events): Everything on events side looks good. :thumbsup:

Maria (partnerships): Thanks all — we'll do a 30-min dry run Mon 16:00 via Zoom. Link in calendar.
